g.text: Rendered evidence from captured output
Observed at +12.903975248336792s — page 9
d, and any actions awaiting human approval.\n- [Connect an MCP server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/co
nnect-an-mcp-server.md): Starts a connection request for an MCP server URL. Discovery, browser consent, and validation happen asyn
chronously; poll the returned `connectionRequestId` until the status is terminal. When the next step belongs to a person, the resp
onse carries a `handoffUrl` to open.\n- [Get a connection request](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/get-a-
connection-request.md): Current state of one connection request. Metered on its own poll budget rather than the shared per-caller
one, so polling on a short interval is expected and will not spend the budget your other calls need. A 429 here means the poll int
erval itself is too fast; honour Retry-After.\n- [Cancel a connection request](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connec
tions/cancel-a-connection-request.md): Stops a request and invalidates its handoff link. Cancelling an already-terminal request is
a no-op.\n- [Retry validation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/retry-validation.md): Re-arms a stalled v
alidation immediately instead of waiting out its backoff. Does not revive a terminal request — after `failed`, `expired`, or `canc
elled`, start a new one.\n- [List personas](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-personas.md): The project's personas
, newest first. Archived personas are excluded.\n- [Create a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/create-a-person
a.md): Creates one persona. To draft several with a model first, use `POST /projects/{projectId}/personas/generate` — that route p
ersists nothing.\n- [Get a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-persona.md): A persona that lives in a DIFF
ERENT project answers 404, never 403 — the route is not an existence oracle for a project you cannot see.\n- [Delete a persona](ht
tps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/delete-a-persona.md): Refused with 409 while goals still reference this persona — delet
ing it would strand them.\n- [Update a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-persona.md): Partial update.
Goals reference the persona by id, so renaming one does not disturb anything pointing at it.\n- [Draft personas with a model](htt
ps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/draft-personas-with-a-model.md): Returns DRAFTS and persists nothing. That separation is
deliberate: generation is the step most likely to produce something nobody wanted, and a route that both invented and saved would
make \"let me see what you'd suggest\" indistinguishable from \"fill my project with these\".\n- [Draft journeys for a persona](h
ttps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/draft-journeys-for-a-persona.md): Returns DRAFTS and persists nothing — see `POST /pro
jects/{projectId}/personas/generate` for why, and for the quota this counts against.\n- [Get a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/ap
i-reference/swarms/get-a-journey.md)\n- [Archive a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/archive-a-journey.md): AR
CHIVES rather than deletes, and the response says so. Existing runs keep pointing at the definition they executed, so their histor
y stays readable.\n- [Update a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-journey.md): Editing a goal never di
sturbs a run already under way: a run pins its own immutable snapshot of the definition at launch.\n- [List swarms](https://docs.m
cpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-swarms.md)\n- [Create a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/create-a-swarm.md)
: A swarm is an authoring container holding DEFAULTS for the goals made under it. Creating one starts nothing.\n- [Get a swarm](ht
tps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-swarm.md)\n- [Archive a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/archi
ve-a-swarm.md): ARCHIVES the container. The goals authored under it are not touched — they keep their own definitions and stay lau
nchable.\n- [Update a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-swarm.md): Changes the container's DEFAULTS. Go
als already authored under it keep the values they were created with — this is not a cascade.\n- [List journeys](https://docs.mcpj
am.com/api-reference/swarms/list-journeys.md): The project's goals, newest first. Archived goals are excluded.\n- [Create a journe
y](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/create-a-journey.md): Creates one goal: a persona pursuing a task against one or m
ore environments. To draft several with a model first, use `POST /projects/{projectId}/goals/generate` — that route persists nothi
ng.\n- [List secrets](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/list-secrets.md): The project's credentials as METADATA ONLY —
no value is returned by this or any other route. Shows the project-shared secrets plus the caller's own personal ones; another me
mber's personal secret does not appear at all, not even its name.\n- [Create a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secre
ts/create-a-secret.md): Store a credential so environments can grant it to runs. THE VALUE TRAVELS IN THE REQUEST BODY and becomes
visible to whatever makes the call. The response is metadata only. Creating a project-shared secret requires project admin; a per
sonal one does not.\n- [Get a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/get-a-secret.md): One secret's metadata: deliv
ery mode, host binding, sharing, and when it was last handed to a run. Never its value. A secret from another project — and anothe
r member's personal secret — both read as 404.\n- [Delete a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/delete-a-secret.
md): Delete a stored credential. HARD — the row and the encrypted value both go, and MCPJam stops delivering it. Deliberately NOT
blocked when an environment still selects it: refusing would leave a leaked credential undeletable until someone edited every envi
ronment naming it, and deletion must never wa…\n- [Rotate or re-bind a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/rotat
e-or-re-bind-a-secret.md): Rotate the value and/or change how it is delivered. A rotation reaches NEW RUNS ONLY: a session already
running holds the old value — materialized in its box's environment, or inside an egress policy that cannot be read back — and th
ere is no safe way to replace it mid-run.\n- [List a journey's runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/list-a-journ
eys-runs.md): Newest first. Compact records — `attempts` is on the single-run read.\n- [Launch a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/
api-reference/swarm-runs/launch-a-journey.md): Answers **202**: the run row exists and its fan-out has started. It is not finished
— poll `GET /projects/{projectId}/goal-runs/{runId}` until `status` leaves `running`.\n- [Get a journey run](https://docs.mcpjam.
com/api-reference/swarm-runs/get-a-journey-run.md): The full record, including per-session `attempts` and `targetSummaries`.\n- [L
ist a run's sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/list-a-runs-sessions.md): One entry per chat session the ru
n produced. Summaries, not transcripts — read a transcript through the chat-session routes using `id`.\n- [Cancel a journey run](h
ttps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/cancel-a-journey-run.md): Accepts a durable Stop request and returns immediately.
cleanupPending indicates that attempts are being settled in the background; status remains the current stored run status. IDEMPOTE
NT: cancelling an already-cancelled run answers 200 with `alreadyCanceled: true` and `finalized: 0`, not a 409.\n- [Project swarm
roll-up](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/project-swarm-roll-up.md): Recent runs with their goal-completion ra
tes and repeat-failure findings, plus a project-wide trend. Deterministic and free — start here.\n- [Get a run's rubric scorecard]
(https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/get-a-runs-rubric-scorecard.md): The deterministic rubric result for one run
. No model, no spend.\n- [List swarm findings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/list-swarm-findings.md): Crite
ria that keep failing, tracked across waves. One finding is one problem OVER TIME — `occurrenceCount` and `status` carry the histo
ry, so do not treat repeat appearances as separate problems.\n- [Dismiss a finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-in
